exposure: Type of hospital (public vs. private not-for-profit)
cohort: Patients undergoing common surgical procedures at a general district hospital (public) and a mission hospital (private, not-for-profit) in the Iganga and Mayuge districts in eastern Uganda
finding: The cost of surgery was higher at the mission hospital, with higher expenditure and lower productivity than the public hospital.
mod_finding: The most commonly performed major procedure was caesarean section, with costs varying between $68.4 and $74.4.
